notes: 1. Campaign types = STATIC (all buyers see all units at once), DYNAMIC (round-based; only the active round selects), PHYSICAL_EVENT (walk-in; admin/SM assigns units offline). Type drives the detail page: Static = 3 KPI cards, Physical Event = 6 KPI cards + Notify + Download Pending, Dynamic = a 'Round-Wise Data' section.

2. Campaign lifecycle = Upcoming -> Active -> Completed (auto at end time). Upcoming -> Cancelled (manual, before start). Active -> Stopped (manual, before end). Active -> Failed (system error). Row actions are status-driven: Active row = View + Stop; Upcoming row = View + Cancel; Completed/Stopped/Cancelled/Failed = View only.

3. [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED] = a disposable UAT campaign/registration/unit in the right state (e.g. an Active campaign for Stop, an Upcoming campaign for Cancel, a Physical Event Completed campaign for Notify) must be supplied before executing this test. Ask the user for the exact project + campaign + registration to use.
4. [VERIFY WITH DEV] = behaviour not confirmed in BRD/FRD/FS or contradicted by a documented backend gap; confirm before treating Pass/Fail as authoritative.

5. DESTRUCTIVE-OPEN-ONLY: per Pipeline Discipline rule #7, Stop / Cancel / Notify and Create-Save are NEVER confirmed on UAT in this batch. The test OPENS the modal/form, ASSERTS the title/body/buttons, then CLOSES (Close/Cancel/Reset) without firing the mutation. The expected result states this explicitly. A real end-to-end mutation requires explicit user authorisation and [TEST_DATA_REQUIRED].

6. The Stop button label to DISMISS the Stop modal is 'Close' (not 'Cancel'); the confirm button is 'Yes, Stop Now' (red). The Cancel modal uses 'Close' + 'Yes, Cancel' (red). The Notify modal uses 'Cancel' + 'Yes, Notify All' (blue).
7. Status flip on Stop/Cancel is ASYNC via a Python callback (BRD/FS gap GAP-DEV-010, §10.18) — do NOT assert status==Stopped synchronously right after clicking confirm; poll/refresh.

8. 'Approved' is NOT a campaign-list status. The Status filter offers: All Status / Active / Upcoming / Completed / Stopped / Cancelled / Failed. Any TC mentioning 'Approved' refers to a buyer/registrant state in the Customers module, not Allocation.

9. DOCUMENTED BACKEND GAPS (do NOT write pass/fail against these): (a) FAILED status is never observable in the list — markAllocationCampaignFailed DESTROYS the row instead of setting status='FAILED' (§10/GAP-DEV-011); a FAILED filter returns empty. (b) cancelUserAllocation ownership check is broken — any authenticated user can cancel any registrationUnit by ID; do NOT write a 403 cross-user test (§10/GAP-TL-008). (c) No DB uniqueness on assigned unit_id -> double-booking race is OUT OF SCOPE for functional regression (§10/GAP-DEV-034). (d) createPaymentIntent has no validation — not tested (§10.15).

10. projectId is env-defaulted (1 prod / 2 UAT) when omitted; the 'Project ID is required' server check is dead code (§10.1). PHYSICAL_EVENT requires commonPoolExcel; STATIC/DYNAMIC accept allotmentExcel; missing -> HTTP 400 (§10.2). Excel validation errors return an XLSX binary body, not JSON (§10.3). Stop/Cancel likely route through one updateAllocationCampaign PUT with an 'action' field, not separate /stop and /cancel routes (§10.7, DOC_DRIFT-ALLOC-001).

11. Notifications are SILENT by design on campaign create, activate, stop, and cancel — asserting 'no SMS/WhatsApp/email is dispatched' is a REQUIRED test, not an omission (FS Feature 1/3/4 §8). The only campaign-launch notification path is the explicit admin Notify action (PHYSICAL_EVENT only): generates unique QR codes + notifies registrants via SMS/WhatsApp (Kaleyra). Buyer payment success/failure separately fires WhatsApp + SMS (no email), +91 phones only (FS Feature 5 §8).
12. Admin master OTP = 258369; UAT admin mobile = 8888888888. UAT recommendation: only one Active campaign at a time; Start Time must be at least 3 minutes in the future.
docDrift: DOC_DRIFT-ALLOC-001: FRD §11 and FS Feature 3 §7 / Feature 4 §7 document SEPARATE routes PUT /campaigns/:id/stop and PUT /campaigns/:id/cancel. BRD §10.7 (GAP-TL-007) and the live behaviour reconcile to a SINGLE updateAllocationCampaign PUT taking an 'action' field. Live implementation (action-field) is authoritative. RESOLUTION: BRD/FS already carry the §10.7 correction; FRD §11 route table is the stale copy. Recommend FRD §11 be annotated to point at the single action-field endpoint. TCs use the action-field model (TC_ALLOC_API_008). No separate-route pass/fail asserted.

DOC_DRIFT-ALLOC-002: FRD §3 / FS Feature 1 describe an 'Export' capability and FRD §11 lists an allotments/export endpoint, but the live Admin build has NO button labelled 'Export'. The equivalent live controls are 'Download Bookings' (all types) and 'Download Pending' (Physical Event only) inside the 'Campaign Actions' card on the detail page (INDEX.md Export-UI section). Live UI labels are authoritative. RESOLUTION: TCs use the live 'Download Bookings' / 'Download Pending' labels (TC_ALLOC_FUNC_020/021); recommend FRD/FS wording be updated from 'Export' to the two Download buttons. No 'Export button' pass/fail asserted.

DOC_DRIFT-ALLOC-003: FRD §3 (Page Layout) instructs 'Allocation Type ... Default: Static - DO NOT change' as an automation convenience note, while BRD §3 and FS Feature 1 define all three types (Static/Dynamic/Physical Event) as first-class. The three-type model is authoritative for coverage; the 'DO NOT change' note is an old automation shortcut, not a product rule. TCs cover all three types. No drift to BRD/FS; FRD note is non-binding.
